title: Pourquoi apprendre le français protège votre cerveau du vieillissement
description:
Dear French learner over 60, 

What science has discovered about languages and the ageing brain is something every person over 60 deserves to know, and it has nothing to do with being gifted, or starting young, or being perfectly fluent.

It has everything to do with the simple, daily effort of navigating between two languages. 

Even gently. Even imperfectly. Even ten minutes a day.

In this video:

⭐ What actually happens in the brain as we age — and why it is not inevitable
⭐ What cognitive reserve is — and why it is your brain's most powerful protection
⭐ What science says about languages and cognitive ageing
⭐ Why stories and narration are particularly protective — and why ten minutes a day is enough

You may be learning French for a trip. For a grandchild. For the joy of a beautiful language.
And in doing so, without knowing it, you may be doing something far greater!

You are taking care of who you are.

A new French story every Saturday on this channel — free, gentle, and made for you.
